text: “Who’s there?” I repeated. An instant of silence followed, and then we heard the light fall of the footsteps again, fainter and fainter—sinking away into the darkness—sinking, sinking, sinking—till they were lost in the silence. We hurried out from the trees to the open lawn beyond, crossed it rapidly; and without another word passing between us, reached the house. In the light of the hall-lamp Laura looked at me, with white cheeks and startled eyes. “I am half dead with fear,” she said.
